_doc: Maps the raw `combine_with` strings from miniapp / mini-program orders to actual product SKUs in our catalog. Used by scripts/backfill_addons.js and (going forward) by routes that import sales. Strings not present here are treated as 'no addon' (e.g. customer chose 'Nothing thanks'). Heat flag (不加热/加热) is intentionally collapsed — it's a kitchen instruction, not a separate item.
